title: Adonai Mitchell sees ‘explosive’ potential with Garrett Wilson as Jets’ new WR duo

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Adonai Mitchell sees ‘explosive’ potential with Garrett Wilson as Jets’ new WR duo
sources.description: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell is set to open the season as Geno Smith's No. 2 target alongside Garrett Wilson after building chemistry this summer.
